title: Add-on store
text: Modules beyond your plan. Try one free, or add it month by month; cancel any time and its data stays.
closed: The add-on store is closed for this account. Ask your provider if you need another module.
ask_provider: Add-ons for this account are started by {provider}. Contact them to add a module.
view_only: You can see the store. Only the account owner or an administrator can add or cancel modules.
empty_text: No module matches. Clear the search or pick another filter.
price_provider: Your provider bills you for this
price_provider_set: {price} a month, billed by your provider
in_plan_off: In your plan. Turn it on under Modules.

confirm.trial_text: It turns on for your whole account for {days} days, free. Each module can be tried once. When the trial ends it turns off unless you add it; your data stays.
confirm.buy_text: It turns on at once for your whole account. {price}, from today, month by month. The first month's invoice will be under Billing.
confirm.buy_provider_text: It turns on at once for your whole account. {provider} bills you for it.
confirm.cancel_text: It stays on until {date}, then turns off. Its data is kept, and you can add it again later.
confirm.cancel_trial_text: The trial ends now and the module turns off. Its data is kept.
confirm.resume_text: It carries on month by month as before.

partner.title: Add-on prices
partner.text: Modules your clients can add beyond their plan. Leave a price empty to use the platform's; your own price applies to new months from today.
partner.empty_text: The platform has not priced any add-on you may offer yet.
partner.save_text: Your clients will pay {price} a month from their next month on.
partner.reset_text: Your clients will pay the platform's price ({price}) from their next month on.
partner.client_text: Add or cancel a module for one client, for example when your clients do not buy add-ons themselves.
partner.client_nothing: Nothing can be added for this client.
partner.buy_text: It turns on at once for {client}'s whole account and is billed month by month.
partner.platform_text: Every module the platform sells beyond a plan: what clients pay (list) and what wholesale partners pay us (wholesale), per currency and month. Empty: not sold in that currency. A new price applies to new months from today.
partner.platform_save_text: The platform price becomes {price} a month, for new months from today.
partner.platform_stop_text: It will no longer be sold in {currency} at the platform price (partners with their own price still sell it).
partner.reset_unpriced_text: The platform does not price it in this currency, so your clients will not be able to add it.
